request: 응 좋아~ 디아블로2 관련된거 5개도 추가해줄수 있어?
scope: Research five additional Diablo II / Diablo II: Resurrected development-tech Shorts candidates. Preserve previous five ideas. No production or platform action requested.
recommendationReason: Changing only visible width reveals a surprising gameplay constraint. Explain the historical alpha problem with a labeled reconstruction rather than claiming a current released-build exploit.

comparison.coverage: Existing worklist and prior 70-title snapshot compared; no exhaustive present-day transcript or worldwide uniqueness claim.
comparison.result: No Diablo-specific candidate in these inventories. General billboard, FOV, grass and network topics are adjacent; keep these concrete developer decisions as the focus.

ultrawide.kind: Archived original Blizzard community-team statement, PezRadar, September 7 2021
ultrawide.readScope: Ultrawide Support Changes: alpha 21:9 exposure, attacks outside intended AI reaction range and release-era 19:9 compromise.
ultrawide.originalForumRetrieval: Original d3 forum topic 44360 returned 404; cite the preserved official statement with archive attribution.

authenticity.kind: Direct interviews with Rob Gallerani, Michael Bukowski, Dustin King and Chris Lena
authenticity.readScope: Full developer interview, especially Cascading Effects (input adaptation) and The Guiding Light (item visibility, grass displacement, renderer and animation).

originalPostmortem.kind: Original developer postmortem by Erich Schaefer, October 2000
originalPostmortem.readScope: Component appearance system; paper dolls and separately rendered head, torso, legs, arms, weapons and shields; 3D art rendered from multiple angles.

renderer.kind: Direct interview with Andre Abrahamian and Matthew Cederquist, February 2021
renderer.readScope: Technology-layering question and answer: new 3D rendering on the underlying game and preservation of collision and pathfinding rules.

candidates.title: 모니터를 넓혔더니 몬스터가 반격을 못 했다?
candidates.game: Diablo II: Resurrected, 2021 technical-alpha development case
candidates.technique: Visible area versus AI activation/reaction range / 화면 가시 범위와 AI 반응 범위의 불일치
candidates.verifiedClaim: The team reported that 21:9 alpha views allowed ranged attacks beyond intended AI response limits and adopted a 19:9 viewing limit with side vignettes for release.
visualPlan: Current actual game establishes the viewport and ranged combat
Our reconstruction keeps player and monster fixed while widening only the visible area
Separately label the extra visible region and AI response boundary
Show why the historical width compromise prevented that mismatch
limits: Do not claim the historical alpha defect is reproduced in today's official build.
The guide boundary is illustrative, not a recovered radius or measured detector result.
Keep view width, attack reach and AI response conceptually separate; changing monitor hardware does not make every monster universally passive.
If historical alpha gameplay cannot be independently licensed and verified in FHD, show a clearly labeled own reconstruction for the defect.
candidates.productionStatus: candidate-only; footage/rights and exact current build behavior pending

candidates.title: 아이템이 풀에 가려지자, 풀이 비켜줬다
candidates.technique: Item-triggered vegetation displacement / 아이템 가독성을 위한 식생 변위
candidates.verifiedClaim: Dustin King describes added 3D grass hiding dropped items and technology that moves grass out of their way to improve visibility.
visualPlan: Actual item drop in grass, if the displacement is visibly verifiable
Same own grass patch and item before the visibility fix
Enable displacement around the item without moving the item
Reveal the readable silhouette and return to the game
limits: The technique name is descriptive; the interview does not name a proprietary algorithm.
Do not assert exact shader, radius, force or grass-removal implementation.
Do not equate this item-triggered change with character footprints or wind.
Prior leaf-updraft Short also addresses VFX readability, but this one must teach object-triggered vegetation clearance rather than reuse the prior wind mechanism.
candidates.productionStatus: candidate-only; acquire and inspect a clear actual drop before finalizing narration

candidates.title: 디아2는 갑옷을 갈아입을 때 그림 조각을 바꿨다?
candidates.technique: Component-based sprite animation / 부품 조합형 스프라이트 애니메이션
candidates.verifiedClaim: Separate renders of armor/body parts, weapon and shield support many combined character appearances; source art was modeled in 3D and exported as views for the game.
visualPlan: Actual original or verified legacy-mode character swaps equipment
Own sprite rig separates into head, torso, arms, legs, weapon and shield
Replace one matching animated component while preserving pose and timing
Recombine and turn the character to show synchronized views
limits: Apply the sprite explanation to the original renderer, not Resurrected's modern 3D models.
Do not imply every inventory item has a globally unique visible sprite.
Any combinatorial example counts are ours, not a claim about exact shipped asset totals.
Focus on modular appearances, distinct from the prior reference channel's generic billboard technique.
candidates.productionStatus: candidate-only; independent FHD capture of original-resolution game and asset provenance pending

candidates.title: G키 하나로 20년 전 그래픽으로 돌아가는 비밀
candidates.technique: Separation of game logic and rendering / 게임 로직과 렌더링의 분리
candidates.verifiedClaim: The new rendering layer follows the underlying game's state and established collision/pathfinding rules, enabling the classic/modern visual toggle and smoother visual animation.
visualPlan: Actual classic/modern graphics toggle during one continuous action
One position/health/action-state track feeds two illustration render views
Keep gameplay events aligned while only the presentation changes
Return to the real toggle at the same game event
limits: Do not describe two independent matches running in parallel.
Do not claim all Resurrected code, balance or later patches are unchanged from 2000.
No exact 25Hz/timing claim is locked by this research record; verify the original technical statement before making numeric claims in a script.
Avoid framing it as merely a texture filter or a prerecorded graphics swap.
candidates.productionStatus: candidate-only; capture and inspect the actual input and uninterrupted state transition

candidates.title: 패드로 조작하는데, 게임은 마우스 입력을 받는다?
